row: Life and Beauty with Sophia Daley

I’m Sophia Daley  a Licensed Beauty Therapist, Certified Massage Therapist, and Beauty Trainer with a passion for helping women glow from the inside out. On this channel, I share beauty tutorials, lifestyle vlogs, self-care tips, and wellness inspiration designed to empower you to look and feel your best every day.

From makeup and hair tutorials to wellness practices and real-life lifestyle moments, you’ll find content that blends professional knowledge with personal inspiration.

💄 Beauty | 🌸 Lifestyle | 💆 Wellness | ✨ Faith & Motivation

📌 Subscribe and join me on this journey of living beautifully, inside and out.
